### Understanding Husbands
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/understanding-husbands
Passage: 1 Peter 3:7
Points:
- Husbands must lead their wives with understanding and gentleness rather than harshness or abuse of power.
- Referring to the wife as the weaker vessel implies no spiritual inferiority, as both spouses are equal co-heirs of grace.
- Treating a wife with honor and dignity is essential for keeping a husband's prayers from being hindered.
- Biblical love is never genuine without active esteem and respect demonstrated in daily conduct.

### PowerPoint - Nov. 6, 2008
Author: PowerPoint Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-nov-6-2008-11595358.html
Passage: 1 Peter 3:1-2
Points:
- Fulfilling marriage requires unconditional devotion and an understanding of biblical roles.
- Wives are called to yield authority voluntarily out of love rather than through coercion.
- Submitting does not denote inferiority, just as Christ remains fully equal to the Father while submitting to Him.
- Cultivating inner serenity and a gentle spirit reflects the true beauty of Christ's character.
- A godly lifestyle and reverent behavior can reach and persuade an unbelieving husband without speaking a word.
